name: SumoSign
description: Handles the signature workflow through SumoSign: documents go up, fields get positioned, and the request goes out to a human signer. Runs on the customer's own API key, which new accounts receive free at signup.

official.title: Meeting to Money by Keith
official.description: Turns a sales meeting into a priced proposal, a signed go-ahead, an invoice, and payment chase. You approve every send. For freelancers and small agencies.
